name: Macrogryphosaurus
sum: A large elasmarian ornithopod from the Coniacian Sierra Barrosa Formation of Neuquén, Argentina, with mineralized plates on its ribs.
wsnote: Described as a large ornithopod; no numbers in the sources used.
holotype: MUCPv-32, an essentially complete set of vertebrae, ribs, four mineralized thoracic plates, both sides of the shoulder girdle and a sternum.
biology: Noted for the mineralized thoracic plates; function is unknown.
author: Calvo et al. 2007

sources.text: J. O. Calvo, J. D. Porfiri, and F. E. Novas. 2007. Discovery of a new ornithopod dinosaur from the Portezuelo Formation (Upper Cretaceous), Neuquén, Patagonia, Argentina. Arquivos do Museu Nacional, Rio de Janeiro 65(4):471-483
